title: New domain-agnostic candidate features: sign stability IndEgo vs Ego10K
why: 14/26 E5 features flip sign OOD; need candidates that survive
hypothesis: compression variability, hand-region motion excess and illumination/scale invariants keep their sign
method: per-feature signed AUROC, E5.03 transfer rule; clip-bootstrap (IndEgo) + window-bootstrap (OOD) CI

summary: 20 candidates: 9 stable / 11 flip. Stable: ct_fsize_std, ct_fsize_cv, inv_clip_frac, inv_laplacian_var, inv_hist_entropy, mo_hand_motion_excess, inv_dct_hf_lf, ct_iframe_frac, ct_fsize_entropy. Flips: absolute bitrate/frame-size, all raw motion residuals (translation AND full affine), noise_snr, dhash.
decision: advance stable candidates to the combination test

title: Family verdicts: compression / affine ego-motion / invariants
hypothesis: affine fix restores motion sign; absolute bitrate transfers

summary: Affine fix did NOT restore sign (mo_affine_resid 0.322/0.728 flips, same as translation-only 0.301/0.704). Absolute bitrate flips (0.376/0.802). Survivors: hand-region motion EXCESS (0.649/0.771), compression variability ct_fsize_std (0.620/0.747), invariants clip_frac/laplacian_var/hist_entropy.
decision: drop raw motion and absolute bitrate; keep hand-excess, size-variability, invariants

title: Combine transferable subset with the 8 sign-stable E5 features
hypothesis: stable candidates + stable-8 beat the frozen ensemble OOD
method: IndEgo LOCO logistic + OOD zero-shot + OOD factory-grouped CV; plus per-domain z-score signed equal-weight

summary: Raw-feature logistic zero-shot OOD 0.497 (stable8+6) - collapses. Per-domain z-score signed equal-weight: 6-transferable IndEgo 0.684 / OOD 0.852 [0.732,0.950]; stable8+6 IndEgo 0.736 / OOD 0.841 [0.712,0.942]. Frozen ensemble OOD 0.415. OOD few-shot (factory CV) 0.776.
decision: Adopt per-domain normalised transferable score; cross-domain failure is largely scale/offset, not concept
